title: India-UK CETA and Social Security Agreement (DCC) Enter Force on July 15, 2026
summary: Unlocks immediate duty-free access on 99% of tariff lines and extends social security exemption to 5 years.

blocks.content: Unlocks immediate duty-free access on 99% of tariff lines and extends social security exemption to 5 years.

items: Trade Accord: India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) in force July 15, 2026.
Social Security (DCC): Double Contribution Convention (DCC) extends social security exemption from 3 to 5 years.
Tariff Relief: Provides immediate duty-free market access on 99% of Indian export tariff lines.
